newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Howard says by-election win a 'big ask'.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Howard says by-election win a 'big ask'.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Friday it might be an unrealistic expectation for his ruling Liberal Party to win a by-election to be held in the Sydney seat of Lindsay on Saturday.
"It's a very big ask," he told reporters.
"It's always been a safe Labor seat."

The High Court ordered the by-election when it found that Liberal candidate Jackie Kelly, who won the seat from the Labor Party's Ross Free in the March 2 election, contravened the constitution by working for the government as an airforce member and for holding dual Australian-New Zealand citizenship.

The Liberal Party has said previously it was unlikely to retain the seat because of a preference swap deal between Free, who is again running as the Labor candidate, and the Australians Against Further Immigration.
